hook: Germanidis co-founded the generative-video company Runway in 2018 and served as its CTO for over seven years before becoming Co-CEO in 2026. Before Runway he worked in machine learning and computer vision at IBM Research and as a backend engineer at Zocdoc, Chartbeat, and Quantcast.
name: Anastasis Germanidis

timeline.impact: Early backend engineering role in the San Francisco Bay Area
Works on backend systems for over a year and a half in New York
Summer and fall research internship in computer vision
Works in backend engineering for six months before co-founding Runway

timeline.event: MPS, Interactive Telecommunications Program, New York University

timeline.impact: Leads technology for over seven years at the generative-video AI company, based in the New York City area
Moves into the Co-CEO role alongside continuing as co-founder

quick_facts: Co-founded Runway in November 2018 and has led it continuously since, first as CTO and now as Co-CEO
MPS in Human-Computer Interaction, New York University; BA in Computer Science, Wesleyan University
Previously a machine learning researcher in computer vision at IBM Research
Held backend engineering roles at Zocdoc, Chartbeat, and Quantcast before Runway

achievements.title: Co-Founder and CTO, Runway, 2018-2026
achievements.impact: Led technology for over seven years at one of the leading generative-video AI companies.

achievements.title: Co-Founder and Co-CEO, Runway, 2026-present
achievements.impact: Moved into a co-CEO role at Runway in 2026.
